mapper.select: SELECT spr.role_id FROM sys_position sp INNER JOIN sys_user_position sup ON sp.id = sup.position_id AND sp.org_id = sup.group_id INNER JOIN sys_position_role spr ON spr.position_id = sp.id WHERE sup.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND sp.org_id = #{groupId, jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT sp.id, sp.post_name, sp.perm_scope,sp.state,sp.perm_scope,sp.be_manager,sp.note FROM sys_position sp LEFT JOIN sys_user_position sup ON sp.id = sup.position_id AND sp.org_id = sup.group_id WHERE sup.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND sp.org_id = #{groupId, jdbcType=CHAR}
